steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most professionals in Fresno's agricultural technology and manufacturing sectors qualify. Contact Granite PM Academy to review your background and confirm readiness before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. You'll earn the formal education hours PMI requires, delivered by experienced practitioners teaching current project-management frameworks and real-world case studies relevant to your industry.

steps_items.text: Submit your PMI application with proof of education and experience hours completed through Granite PM Academy. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Our team guides you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning options to help you stay current and renew your credential.
